page.overview:
What is Spike Pod?

The Spike Pods were explosive plants that were native to the planet Genna. When stimulated, they exploded and quickly regenerated. They were commonly used by the Vulture by throwing rocks to them, causing them to release needles and anesthetize their victims.

As noted and exploited by the Yautja Dek, the Spikes Pods and Explosive Grubs can be utilized together as components to craft improvised mines capable of wiping out an entire group of enemies.
